$comment: DT-44: the built-in redaction rules. A window, app or calendar title that matches one is stored as [redacted] (the app name and times stay); a browser extension's site that matches one is stored as [redacted] too. `titles` are regular expressions matched anywhere in a title or site, ignoring case; the (?!\.(py|ts|...)) parts keep a code file named like a word (pharmacy.ts, Clinic.cs) from counting. `apps` are pieces of an app name, app id or site (lowercase) whose titles are always redacted. The user can switch a rule off, or add their own words, from the Privacy page.
